summary_en: This Phase 3 study tests sacituzumab tirumotecan (Sac-TMT, MK-2870) alone or with pembrolizumab (MK-3475) in people with previously untreated, locally recurrent unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer. Sac-TMT is given by IV infusion at 4 mg/kg every 2 weeks until disease progression, toxicity or discontinuation, and pembrolizumab is given by IV infusion at 400 mg every 6 weeks for up to 18 doses (up to about 2 years) in the combination arm, while the comparison arm receives physician's choice chemotherapy. The main goal is to learn whether people live longer overall or live longer without the cancer growing or spreading, compared with chemotherapy.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 3 evalúa sacituzumab tirumotecan (Sac-TMT, MK-2870) solo o con pembrolizumab (MK-3475) en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo, localmente recurrente no resecable o metastásico, que no han recibido tratamiento previo. Sac-TMT se administra por infusión intravenosa a 4 mg/kg cada 2 semanas hasta progresión de la enfermedad, toxicidad o suspensión, y pembrolizumab se administra por infusión intravenosa a 400 mg cada 6 semanas, hasta 18 dosis (hasta unos 2 años) en el brazo de combinación, mientras que el brazo de comparación recibe quimioterapia elegida por el médico. El objetivo principal es saber si las personas viven más tiempo en general o más tiempo sin que el cáncer crezca o se propague, en comparación con la quimioterapia.
who_for: Locally recurrent unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer that cannot be treated with curative intent
No prior systemic treatment for locally recurrent unresectable or metastatic breast cancer
Candidate for pembrolizumab plus paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, or gemcitabine plus carboplatin
Prior early-stage treatment completed at least 6 months before first recurrence
Hepatitis B or C allowed if antiviral treatment or viral control criteria are met
not_for: Breast cancer that can be treated with curative intent
Triple-negative breast cancer with PD-L1 CPS 10 or higher
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis (stable treated brain metastases allowed)
Active or prior inflammatory bowel disease, or severe dry eye or corneal disease
